title: Smok X-Priv Plus Vape Kit
description: The Smok X-Priv Plus Vape Kit is a high-performance sub-ohm kit, ideal for vapers who want powerful, customisable features in a highly interactive and ergonomic design. Powered by two external 18650 batteries (sold separately), easily accessed via a magnetic battery cap, the X-Priv Plus can reach an impressive 225W, delivering astonishing flavours and performance with every inhale. Built with durability in mind, the X-Priv Plus is scratch- and drop-resistant, ensuring it looks as good as it performs. This advanced vape kit features a 2.01” haptic touch display that provides responsive feedback and allows you to navigate through three interactive themes for a fully personalised vaping experience. The haptic screen doesn’t just look great; it provides essential notifications, including vibrating reminders, so you’ll always know when it’s time to recharge. Operate your X-Priv Plus with a simple satisfying click on the large tactile firing button. The X-Priv Plus incorporates USB Type-C charging for fast, convenient recharges, ensuring minimal downtime. The advanced chipset that powers the X-Priv Plus puts doesn’t swerve on safety features, with multiple protections including Intelligent coil recognition, High watts warning, Overtime protection, Short-circuit protection and more. A child-proof lock adds a useful layer of extra security. Included with the kit is Smok’s TF-D Subtank, a 2ml tank equipped with easy top-fill access and skidproof adjustable top airflow to prevent leaks and provide a tailored draw. The TF-D tank is compatible with Smok’s dual-mesh D coils, which are precision-engineered for rapid heating, exceptional flavour, and dense vapour production aided by a unique hexagonal coil structure. Each kit includes a 0.15ohm D coil, recommended for 55-65W, and a 0.23ohm D coil for 45-55W, giving you options to suit your preference. Available in six stunning colours, the Smok X-Priv Plus Vape Kit brings a sophisticated edge to your sub-ohm vape experience. Perfect for vapers who want power, control, and style in one versatile and full-featured device, the X-Priv Plus will elevate your vape sessions to the next level. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
